text: Failure to comply with the request for the exercise of the data subject's ARCO rights, without a well-founded reason, in the terms provided in this Law;
Acting with negligence or malice during the substantiation of requests for the exercise of ARCO rights;
Fraudulently declaring the non-existence of personal data, when it exists totally or partially in the databases of the data controller;
Processing personal data in contravention of the principles set forth in this Law;
Omitting in the privacy notice, any or all of the elements referred to in Article 15 of this Law;

Keeping inaccurate personal data when it is attributable to the data controller, or not carrying out the legally required rectifications or cancellations of the same when the rights of the data subjects are affected;
Failure to comply with the warning referred to in Section I of Article 59 of this Law;
Failure to comply with the duty of confidentiality established in Article 20 of this Law;
Substantially changing the original purpose of the data processing, without observing the provisions of Article 11 of this Law;
Transferring data to third parties without communicating to them the privacy notice containing the limitations to which the data subject has subjected the disclosure of such data;
Violate the security of databases, premises, programs or equipment, when it is attributable to the data controller;
To carry out the transfer or assignment of personal data, outside the cases in which it is permitted by law;
Collect or transfer personal data without the express consent of the data subject, in those cases in which such consent is required;
Obstructing the acts of verification of the authority;
Collecting data in a misleading and fraudulent manner;
Continuing with the illegitimate use of personal data when the cessation of such use has been requested by the Secretariat or the data subjects;
Process personal data in a way that affects or prevents the exercise of the ARCO rights established in Article 16 of the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States;
Create databases in contravention of the provisions of Article 8, second paragraph of this Law, and
Any failure of the data controller to comply with the obligations established in terms of the provisions of this Law.
